question: which effect id is each of the eight ef_stc_* models, what fires it, and under what condition
answer: SIX of the eight are the status system, one is a death event, and one is not reached at all. The status index space is exactly six wide -- two effect-id tables, a bit table, three parameter grids and an immunity table all say six -- and the six-way assignment is confirmed three ways that share no step: arm9 behaviour, the item immunity chain through uniprm.rel, and the attack-side roll.

attack_side.explicit_override: attack+0x3C; when it is not -1 it IS the status index and level/chance/duration come from attack+0x40/+0x44/+0x48 instead of +0x90/+0x94
attack_side.chance: chance * (100 - (defender+0x4C + defender+0x50 + defender+0x54)) / 100, rolled through FUN_02086D8C; skipped entirely when the immunity bit for that index is set in defender+0x30

written_to.+0x0E: duration override, 0 means use the grid

attack_side.carrier_from: FUN_02036148 passes damagePacket+8 as the record

death.condition: bit 30 of the command packet's +0x08 word; bit 31 clear. Bit 30 clear takes the other arm and shows a floating number through FUN_020369C8 instead
death.also_on_that_path: FUN_0207F4FC clears the whole status object first
death.not_a_status: no entry in either 6-slot table; no index maps to 147

eliminated: the two status tables (0x020ED084, 0x020ED16C): six entries each, no 65 -- the status space is six wide and the bit table, the three parameter grids and the immunity table all agree on six
the descriptor +0x54 spawn scan: 64 literal of 98 FUN_02046D94 sites over arm9 and all 32 overlays, 35 distinct ids, no 65
the register-argument scan: 40 literal of 51 effect-API sites, 30 distinct ids, no 65
the enemy attachment table: 314 records, ids {38, 39, 59, 96}

every `movs rX,#65` in arm9 and all 32 overlays followed within 12 halfwords by a BL to any of the seven effect entry points: 0 hits. The two `movs rX,#0x41` that a naive scan reports are struct offsets -- 0x02040C86 is 0x41<<2 = +0x104 and its callee FUN_02036B30 takes one argument

refuted_lead.what: the arrays at 0x020ED338 and 0x020F4434, which open with 59,60,61,62,63,64 and contain 65
refuted_lead.why_it_is_wrong: 0x020ED338 is entries 9..33 of the 34-entry table at 0x020ED314 that FUN_0203AAF0 indexes with the byte at entity+0x4D (`< 0x22`) and passes to FUN_020C193C with 0x020ED204 and 0x020ED28C. Sound ids, not effect ids

unlocated.what_is_left: not a static question yet: the id would have to arrive in a descriptor field written from data, so the next instrument is a savestate with a shock effect on screen

poison_override_correction.claim: id 59 is borrowed as a slot: 0 of its 23 records use ef_stc_poisn's own model, against 39 of 39 for id 96 and 10 of 12 for id 39
poison_override_correction.consequence: the ef_stc_poisn MODEL reaches the screen only through the status path

sound_table_refutation.the_lookalike: 0x020ED338 is entry 9 of this table, and reads 59,60,61,62,63,64,... which is why it passed for an effect-id list
